sure thing... an animal could have a mutation that made him 50% bigger or faster or smarter this would be a great advantage for the individual....BUT if this mutation made the individual sterile it would be completely useless to the species. lets assume that the mutation does not make the animal sterile but simply reduces the birth rate. this individual would by virtue of his improved abilities would become dominant but would pass on his own (lower sperm count, sperm mobility, number of viable sperm or any other reason you can think of) reproduction problems. this would eventually be problematic to the overall population.
